stops.note: meant 'earthen dish, vessel', from a word for 'ground, place'
became the name of a round metal serving plate
stops.meaning: a round metal plate for serving food

stops.note: adopted in English food writing for a full platter meal served on such a plate
stops.meaning: a meal served as small portions on a round platter

current_meaning: A South Asian meal consisting of small portions of several dishes served together on a round platter.
